# Senior AI Engineer — Umbrella Data

**Location:** Remote (EU) · **Type:** Full-time · **Posted:** 2026-08-27

Umbrella Data builds a research assistant for life-sciences teams. We are hiring a senior engineer to
lead our RAG pipeline and agent tooling.

## Responsibilities

- Own the retrieval pipeline: chunking, embeddings, reranking, evaluation
- Design agent workflows over internal scientific databases
- Build prompt- and model-regression evaluation into CI

## Requirements

- 5+ years software engineering, 2+ years hands-on with LLM APIs
- Strong Python; TypeScript a plus
- Experience with retrieval evaluation and vector databases
